verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's docs confirm the core loop: a campaign-creation API (klaviyo-docs-7), drag-and-drop email editors with segmentation/audience tools (klaviyo-docs-11, klaviyo-docs-19, klaviyo-docs-27), and dedicated email marketing product page touting this as its flagship use case (klaviyo-docs-38). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a 'schedule send' step/UI and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
